clue.text: Article about imitation bed covering

indicators.note: the imitation word goes about, i.e. around, the article

parts.note: an imitation is a copy
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone sniffs at a cheap knock-off of a fancy bedspread.
explanation.definitionFit: A canopy is the fabric covering hung over a four-poster bed.

clue.text: Money from a mine in California

indicators.note: the article and the mine are placed in the state abbreviation

parts.note: a pit is a coal mine

explanation.surface: Gold-rush wealth dug out of a Californian mine.
explanation.definitionFit: Capital is money invested or available for investment in a business.

clue.text: Material many longshoremen pick up

indicators.note: the letters are picked up from inside the words many longshoremen

explanation.surface: Dockers handle a lot of synthetic fabric on the quayside.
explanation.definitionFit: Nylon is a synthetic material used for fabrics and stockings.

clue.text: Act as Queen for the afternoon out

indicators.note: the afternoon letters lie out, on the outside, around the others

parts.note: PM, post meridiem, marks the afternoon
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen
taken as written

explanation.surface: An actor plays the monarch for an afternoon away.
explanation.definitionFit: To perform is to act on stage, giving a show.

clue.text: Shake a plant

definitions.meaning: to jolt or agitate something noisily
yellow ... is a meadow plant whose seeds ... in their pods

explanation.surface: A gardener jiggles a houseplant.
explanation.definitionFit: To rattle is to shake noisily, and rattle is also a wild flower with rattling seed pods.

clue.text: Tax a ship by letter

parts.note: SS, steamship, prefixes ships' names
ess is the name of the letter S

explanation.surface: Customs levy duty on a vessel by post.
explanation.definitionFit: To assess is to fix the tax payable, as an assessor does.

clue.text: The first drink boy takes as a bandsman

indicators.note: the first letter of the word The is taken

parts.note: rum is an alcoholic drink
Peter is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A young lad joins a band and has his first tipple.
explanation.definitionFit: A trumpeter is a musician who plays the trumpet in a band.

clue.text: Finish with awfully sore back

parts.note: an end is a finish

indicators.note: the word sore is mangled awfully into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone ends up with a terribly painful back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awfully' rearranges SORE to ORSE. 'back' looks like part of the body in the surface, but it is the verb meaning support.
explanation.definitionFit: To endorse a candidate or plan is to back or support it.

clue.text: Partner in a position to be agreeable

parts.note: a companion is a partner or mate
being able to do something is being in a position to

explanation.surface: Having a partner in the right place makes one pleasant company.
explanation.definitionFit: Companionable means friendly and pleasant to be with, sociable.

clue.text: Stone causing the French river to flow backwards

indicators.note: the French article and the river are read backwards together

parts.note: la is French for the
the Po is the great river of northern Italy

explanation.surface: A boulder dams a river so that it runs back on itself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to flow backwards' turns LA PO into OPAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Opal is a gemstone with shifting iridescent colours.

clue.text: Troubleshooters making disturbances on university campuses

parts.note: riots are violent public disturbances
quads are the quadrangles of college campuses

explanation.surface: Fixers are sent to calm unrest at colleges.
explanation.definitionFit: Police squads that deal with civil disorder are, humorously, troubleshooters: they are sent where trouble is.

clue.text: Drink providing energy on the way in

indicators.note: in an across answer, on means placed after

parts.note: St, street, is a way
taken as written
go is energy or vigour

explanation.surface: A traveller takes a pick-me-up for energy on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: STINGO is an old name for strong ale.
explanation.definitionFit: Stingo is an old word for strong beer, a heady drink.

clue.text: It makes it easier for the traveller to let someone have wine

definitions.text: It makes it easier for the traveller

parts.note: to pass something is to let someone have it
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: Handing round the wine eases a traveller's journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A passport is the travel document that eases a traveller's way across borders.

clue.text: Share in vegetable patch

definitions.meaning: a rented plot of land for growing vegetables, common in Britain

explanation.surface: Someone has a stake in a garden plot.
explanation.definitionFit: An allotment is both an allocated share and a small rented plot for growing vegetables, a British institution.

clue.text: Twisted coils formerly used for swing

indicators.note: the word coils is twisted into a new order

parts.note: late means former, as in the late president

explanation.surface: Bent springs that once held a playground swing.
explanation.definitionFit: To oscillate is to swing back and forth regularly.

clue.text: Infection occurring in the first year

indicators.note: the answer occurs within the run of letters first year

explanation.surface: A child picks up an illness in their first year.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an infected swelling on the eyelid.

clue.text: Sway to music

definitions.meaning: to move gently from side to side
a loud genre of popular music with guitars and drums

explanation.surface: Dancers move gently to the band.
explanation.definitionFit: To rock is to sway to and fro, and rock is also a popular music genre.

clue.text: Accomplish ambition to learn

definitions.meaning: to make an ambition come true
to become aware of or understand something

explanation.surface: A student fulfils a dream of studying.
explanation.definitionFit: One realises an ambition by achieving it, and realises a fact by coming to understand it.

clue.text: Rummaged about for a long time in car

indicators.note: the long time is put in the car make

parts.note: a Ford is a make of car
an age is a long time

explanation.surface: Someone searched their car for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: To forage about is to rummage or search around for something.

clue.text: Speak of former journalists

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
the press is journalists collectively

explanation.surface: A talk about reporters of the past.
explanation.definitionFit: To express a thought is to put it into words, to speak it.

clue.text: Dozy snake takes shelter

indicators.note: the snake takes the shelter inside it

parts.note: an asp is a venomous snake
lee is the sheltered side, as in the lee of a wall

explanation.surface: A drowsy serpent curls up under cover.
explanation.definitionFit: Asleep means sleeping, the state a dozy creature drifts into.

clue.text: Old catapult tip found in Welsh lake

indicators.note: the tip word is found inside the lake's name

parts.note: Bala is the largest natural lake in Wales
to list is to tip or lean, as a ship does

explanation.surface: An ancient siege weapon's tip turns up in a Welsh lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballista was a Roman siege engine, a giant catapult for hurling stones or bolts.

clue.text: Directions for making one crepe mixture

indicators.note: the letters are mixed like batter into a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Instructions for cooking a pancake from batter.
explanation.definitionFit: A recipe is a set of directions for making a dish.

clue.text: Part of poem about Antony leaving New York

parts.note: c, circa, means about

indicators.note: the New York letters leave the name Antony

explanation.surface: A verse section tells of Antony departing New York.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving' takes NY from ANTONY, leaving ANTO.
explanation.definitionFit: A canto is one of the main divisions of a long poem.

clue.text: Quietly angry with standard shown by Captain Hook?

parts.note: p, piano, means quietly in music
irate means angry
a standard is a flag

explanation.surface: The fictional pirate captain glowers silently with his banner flying.
explanation.walkthrough: Captain Hook is the pirate in Peter Pan; the question mark marks him as an example, and 'standard' does double duty in the extended definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A pirate flag, the skull and crossbones, is the kind of banner a pirate captain like Hook flies.

clue.text: Something one has to have

parts.note: a plain description of a necessity, something that cannot be done without

explanation.definitionFit: A need is a requirement, something one must have.

clue.text: Not liable to be a flower politician takes to first

parts.note: a flower is a river, a thing that flows, here the Exe in Devon
MP, Member of Parliament, is a politician

indicators.note: the first letter of the word to is taken

explanation.surface: A gardening MP gets out of paying duty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' means something that flows: the Exe is a river in Devon, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Exempt means free from an obligation, not liable to it.

clue.text: Offensive to see how party rejected evidence of debts

indicators.note: the party word is turned back, rejected

parts.note: a do is a party
IOUs, I owe you notes, are evidence of debts

explanation.surface: It is distasteful to watch a party spurn people who owe money.
explanation.definitionFit: Odious means hateful, offensive or repugnant.
